title: Superlunary
summary: SUPERLU'NARY, a. [L. super and luna, the moon.] Being above the moon; not sublunary or of this world. The head that turns at superlunar things.

inlines.v: SUPERLU'NARY, a. [L. super and luna, the moon.] Being above the moon; not sublunary or of this world. The head that turns at superlunar things.
